title: Malware Clustering in the Wild: Taxonomy, Challenges, and Evaluation Metrics
abstract: arXiv:2611.02380v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As malware continues to grow in volume, diversity, and sophistication, clustering has emerged as a critical technique for analyzing large malware corpora. Clustering enables the discovery of structural relationships, behavioral patterns, and evolutionary trends, and is widely used to group unknown samples, infer malware family boundaries, and identify novel variants. However, existing research remains fragmented, employing a wide range of clustering techniques with no unified perspective that systematically organizes prior work or clearly identifies gaps in the literature. This survey addresses this gap by organizing previous malware clustering research into seven categories: centroid-based, hierarchical-based, density-based, distribution-based, mixed- type, fuzzy, and AI-driven approaches. translated_title: 野外环境中的恶意软件聚类：分类法、挑战与评估指标
translated_abstract: 随着恶意软件在数量、多样性和复杂性方面的持续增长，聚类已成为分析大规模恶意软件语料库的关键技术。聚类能够发现结构关系、行为模式和演化趋势，并广泛用于对未知样本进行分组、推断恶意软件家族边界以及识别新型变种。然而，现有研究仍然较为零散，采用了各种各样的聚类技术，缺乏统一的视角来系统地组织先前的研究工作或明确指出文献中的空白。本综述通过将以往的恶意软件聚类研究归纳为七大类别来填补这一空白：基于质心的方法、基于层次的方法、基于密度的方法、基于分布的方法、混合类型方法、模糊方法和AI驱动的方法。此外，本综述还总结了聚类研究中常用的公开恶意软件数据集，并考察了特征表示方法。
tldr: 本综述系统地将恶意软件聚类研究归纳为七大类方法，并总结了常用的公开数据集与评估指标，为该领域提供了统一的分类框架并明确了研究空白。
en_tdlr: This survey systematically organizes malware clustering research into seven categories, summarizes commonly used public datasets and evaluation metrics, providing a unified taxonomy and identifying research gaps in the field.
